originality.rationale: Nearest priors checked substantively via live fetch and abstract comparison, not timestamp. Marks 1304.3830 decides vertex K_n cells via determinacy games, no edge predicate, no H0. Brandt et al 2111.03683 proves Sigma^1_2-completeness of general Delta-colorability for acyclic homomorphism graphs, decides no fixed cyclic fiber-ladder edge cell. Conley et al 1611.02204 computes Borel chromatic/edge spectra only for acyclic hyperfinite graphs per abstract (plus LLL failures); H0 has 6-cycle fibers so outside that classification. Bernshteyn 2004.04905 gives general distributed/LLL transfer machinery, no (H0,A*,G*) or (H0,c,toast) instance. Bowen-Weilacher 2112.10222 gives Baire <=Delta+1 (=4 for Delta=3) and Borel <=Delta+asi, leaving exact 3-vs-4 open and publishing no H0 rule. Csoka et al measurable d+1 gives 4, not 3. No source contains odometer fiber-ladder H0, its k-relative rule, or toast log. Hence instance datum is new. PASS on originality (novelty of instance), with triviality assessed under value, not originality.

value.rationale: FAIL: textbook instantiation with mechanically implied invariant. H0 is defined as the edge-disjoint union of three Borel perfect matchings spelled out in its definition: links ((x,i,0),(T(x),i,1)), fiber t=0 ((x,i,0),(x,i+k(x),1)), fiber t=1 ((x,i,0),(x,i+k(x)+1,1)). DRAFT proves each vertex sees exactly one edge of each type, i.e. each type is a Borel 1-factor. The lemma 'a Borel graph edge-partitioned into Delta Borel matchings has chi'_Borel<=Delta' is immediate; coloring by type (0,2,1) just reads the definition. Aperiodicity of k(x) is no obstruction because the rule colors by the definitional offset t=j-i-k(x). No toast layering, phase analysis, or Baire-LOCAL work is needed; interfaces are identity because the global rule is already consistent, and DRAFT Sec.7 admits the scaffold 'is a verification layer over a globally consistent rule, not a general toast-construction method' with no claim beyond aligned links. The cited Delta+1 bounds (Bowen-Weilacher, Csoka) giving 4 are therefore irrelevant: the exact value 3 is baked into the construction, not an open 3-vs-4 cell decided by investigation. Odometer/C6 trappings do not make the invariant non-mechanical; a future researcher sees the 3-coloring directly from the defining edge partition without retrieving the certificate. No reusable bridge, dichotomy entry, or benchmark use survives because any graph defined as 3 explicit Borel matchings is identically class-1. This is a textbook restatement / mere instantiation even though correct and new. Intrinsic low value; no bounded addition (motivation paragraph, literature position) can supply the missing substantive content without changing the problem, so not repairable.
